The '''''Marauder''''' was an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] in the [[Imperial Navy]] under the command of [[Brom Titus]]<ref name="ITNOTR" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Chronology Note" /> It was destroyed when the [[Jalindi Station|Jalindi relay]] was [[Mission to Jalindi|blown up]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[Partisans|extremist]] [[Saw Gerrera]].<ref name="ITNOTR" />
